title: The Art of Dental Prosthetics
subtitle: Sami & Mina are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🦷✨

Sami is an enthusiastic dentist, always ready to propose the most aesthetic solution: 'Ceramic crown, it's the best!' Mina, more thoughtful, tempers: 'And the material? The occlusion? Bruxism?'

Between a crown that becomes uncemented, a bridge that moves, a removable prosthesis that irritates the gum, or a patient who wants veneers, prosthetics is a true art.

A poor choice of material, an inaccurate impression, an occlusion not respected, and the prosthesis fails. Rigorous planning, a good therapeutic choice, and the patient regains smile and function.

The quality of prostheses, patient satisfaction, and the longevity of restorations rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Sami is enthusiastic: 'Ceramic crown, it's the best!' Mina tempers: 'And the material?' Discover the basics of prosthetics: crowns, bridges, inlays, onlays, removable prostheses.
chapters.debutant2: Sami and Mina delve into materials: ceramic, zirconia, metal-ceramic, resin. They discover that each clinical situation has its specific solution.
chapters.intermediaire1: Sami and Mina master prosthetic materials. They learn to choose between ceramic, zirconia, and metal-ceramic according to clinical, aesthetic, and occlusal constraints.
chapters.intermediaire2: Sami and Mina tackle complex cases: long bridges, implant-supported prostheses, CAD/CAM, repairs, failure management. Technique is put to the test.
chapters.expert1: Sami and Mina become references in prosthetics. They train young dentists in the art of prosthetic planning and material selection.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice, Sami and Mina leave a legacy of prosthetic skills. Prosthetics is the art of restoring smile and function.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Sami understood that the choice of material is crucial. Mina is proud of him.
chapterEndings.debutant2: Sami and Mina master basic materials. They are ready for more complex cases.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Mastery of prosthetic materials is acquired. Sami and Mina are experts.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Advanced techniques are mastered. Sami and Mina take on all challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Prosthetic strategy has become a philosophy. Sami and Mina train the next generation.
chapterEndings.expert2: Sami and Mina have accomplished their mission. Prosthetics is the art of restoring the smile.
